name: A Strange Request
summary: In Feralas, Witch Doctor Uzer'i sends you to Orgrimmar for a concoction.

sections.title: A Promised Payment
sections.body: Witch Doctor Uzer'i says Neeru Fireblade in Orgrimmar has a concoction needed to begin work in Feralas. Uzer'i will not yet explain what it is for. You carry a shrunken head, promised to Neeru in exchange for the herbs. It belonged to some poor dwarf Uzer'i came across in the forest. Neeru waits in the Cleft of Shadow.

sections.title: Neeru's Herbs
sections.body: Neeru Fireblade has been waiting for Uzer'i's delivery. In return, Neeru gives you the herb mixture prepared for Uzer'i's experiments.

faq.answer: Witch Doctor Uzer'i sends you to Orgrimmar with a shrunken head.
Neeru Fireblade is in the Cleft of Shadow, in Orgrimmar.

faq.q: Whose head is the shrunken head?
faq.answer: Uzer'i says the head belonged to some poor dwarf found in the forest.

faq.q: Why does Uzer'i send a shrunken head to Neeru?
aliases: why does neeru want the head
faq.answer: Uzer'i promised the head to Neeru in exchange for the herbs, and needs the concoction Neeru has mixed up.
The chain continues with Return to Witch Doctor Uzer'i.
